pages.text: $(thing)White Mold$() ($(o)Sclerotinia sclerotiorum$()), fungus.$(br2)$(li)$(thing)Hosts:$() soybean, common bean, pea, chickpea, lentil, peanut, sunflower, lettuce, cabbage, carrot, potato, tomato.$(li)$(thing)Spreads:$() soilborne, airborne spores.
$(li)$(thing)Favoured by$() 15-25 °C (best 20 °C), humidity above 90%, 16 h of wet leaves.

$(li)$(thing)Survives$() 5 years (sclerotia in soil).$(li)$(thing)Damage:$() up to 50% yield, can kill the plant.$(li)$(thing)Control:$() Rotate with cereals; Wider rows for airflow; Biological control (Coniothyrium minitans).
Hundreds of host species: rotate with grasses, not with other broadleaf crops.
